text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in your DM. I read all six of Moss's notes, and two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers turned up:

- **#PD-4492** is in "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). Drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 in the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments at the gatehouse kiosk. It was patched on 4 Oct.
- **#4419** is in "Moss: North cheat sheet" (undated). Gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14. It went to tier-2 support for firmware testing.

The two descriptions of #4419 don't match. Marcus's own note from 14 Jul 2025, which isn't one of Moss's, calls the same ticket "Gate 3 printer lag." I told Dana to check which is right in the ticket system before it goes in the weekly notes.

I left out tickets that aren't about this account: #4409 and #4412 are on Pree's account, and #4092 is an IT ticket. All the notes I used are public, and ticket numbers count as operational facts, so Dana is allowed to see them.
